partition: Frozen S1/P2; 4096 strict-median leaves of 244/245 objects; not the 4167-block slack initialization
scope: CPU-only offline structural discrimination; 64 fixed query rows, one initial-only PCA-4 family; no CUDA, updates, hierarchy, timing comparison or automatic K8

direction_rule.name: D0 initial-only centered PCA-4
direction_rule.mean: FP64 sum(axis=0) within chunks in physical row order, add chunks in ascending start order, divide N
direction_rule.covariance: Second pass: FP64 centered chunk transpose times centered chunk; add in ascending chunk order; symmetric (C+C.T)/2; divide N; no query/radius/oracle consulted
direction_rule.solver: numpy.linalg.eigh on full D960 covariance, ascending eigenvalues reversed; first four; sign largest-absolute component positive; first dimension wins absolute ties
direction_rule.degeneracy: Abort if any top-four adjacent eigenvalue gap or fourth/fifth boundary <=1e-10*max(1,top eigenvalue); do not invent tied directions
direction_rule.validation: Freeze all 960 eigenvalues, covariance hash, direction bytes and means; repeat eigh on same covariance bitwise; residual<=1e-10 and Gram infinity deviation<=1e-10
direction_rule.portability: Determinism scoped to pinned NumPy/LAPACK/BLAS, thread count and chunk order; directions explicitly retained; bitwise cross-library regeneration not claimed
direction_rule.represented_directions: FP64 D-by-4; numerical near orthonormality is insufficient for safety; exact rational Gram + row-sum spectral bound repairs contraction

numerics: Strict ordered-FP64 dots, no reassociation/FMA; outward absolute dot envelope from one FP32 infinity-norm reduction/vector; exact-rational represented-direction Gram row-sum upper bound A2; lower interval-to-box squared sum; reject only LB2_lower > upward(A2*reference_radius2_upper). Equality retained.

gates.correctness: Any false prune, malformed input, PCA qualification failure or identity mismatch aborts before structural decision
gates.GO_ANISO: BOTH mean<=0.50 and p90<=0.70 and GLOBAL4-minus-box>=0.15; zero false prune
gates.STRONG_GO_ANISO: Must first pass GO_ANISO; then BOTH means<=0.35; label GO_ANISO
gates.NO_GO_PROJECTED_BOX: At least one SAME snapshot box mean>0.65 and GLOBAL4-minus-box<0.10
gates.CONDITIONAL_SUPPORTED: No GO/no NO-GO, both means<=0.65, at least one mean>0.50, and EACH improvement>=0.15
gates.UNCOVERED: CONDITIONAL_ANISO with reason uncovered_interval, K8_admissible=false; not a positive gate
gates.next_phase: No automatic next run. K8 can be separately registered only if specified conditional band passes; GO only permits discussion/design, not launch in this round

cost_proxy.projection: 4 full-D dot products plus one full-D maximum-absolute-coordinate reduction for safe errors, fused in one input pass; do not hide the extra reduction
cost_proxy.endpoints: 8 FP64/block: 262144 bytes for 4096; same endpoint count as GLOBAL4
cost_proxy.directions: 4*960*8=30720 bytes (FP64), versus GLOBAL4 pivots 4*960*4=15360 FP32 bytes; optional pivot IDs separate
cost_proxy.survivors: Add one full-D exact distance per surviving object, without reuse. Report both dot-only+survivor and fully charged 5+survivor reduction-count proxy; operations are not instruction/latency equivalent
cost_proxy.bytes: Logical coordinate payload (one query, shared across projections) plus direction payload plus surviving FP32 coordinates; not actual cache/DRAM traffic
cost_proxy.PCA: Measured wall/process CPU seconds, process peak RSS and explicit live temporary NumPy arrays; reused signatures and data not free; no build-time comparison claimed

runtime.timing: Only offline PCA construction resource accounting, not query/E2E timing

novelty_gate.status: Diagnostic only; no novelty claim for PCA/projection/box filtering
novelty_gate.claim_boundary: Success/failure concerns top-four initial global PCA axes on fixed pivot partition, not a causal proof about all block anisotropy.
